paths.producer: authenticated update_person_profile → internal/external core, travel and profile writers → per-field outcome and canonical scheduling inputs
paths.state: Changed durable scheduling inputs produce the stale-slot instruction on internal and external targets. Applied fields are recorded as such. Mixed non-scheduling changes still report applied. Fixed home work frame and date-limited physical travel are distinct. Mixed invalid hours affect no durable windows; sibling timezone and role are confirmed individually. Actual VIP transitions change the VIP thread-booking constraint, clock edits and fixed travel frames can change eligible intervals, and a changed engagement rank reports an applied social setting.
paths.consumer: structured tool result, scope-local log, and the next model iteration. Downstream model compliance and live calendar mutation are not tested.
paths.guard: receipt compares confirmed scheduling inputs around actual profile writes

paths.producer: authenticated update_person_profile → internal/external core, travel and profile writers → per-field outcome and canonical scheduling inputs
paths.state: No stale-slot instruction for refusal, retry, pure authority promotion, non-scheduling writes or unknown identity. No extra provider mutation, outbox or timer is created. Retries and standalone invalid clocks retain the prior canonical week. Same VIP/rank preserves stored state and produces an already_set receipt. Manual confirmation of identical auto/default intervals and zone persists authority without invalidating slots. Legacy missing hours use the known regional fallback, as in the actual slot reader.
